title: Teacher guide: Pyynikki Future Adventure 2030
intro: The game is the digital task card for a guided outing: the tasks are done at Pyynikki on the students’ own phones and confirmed in the game, which lights a star.

ul: Seven stations: lookout tower, doughnut café, nature trail, culture market, entrepreneurship station, working-life station and TAMK pathway station. The group returns to the tower at the end.
Each station shows the task and the GreenComp and DigComp competences. The group confirms the finished task and receives a star.
There are nine stars: Hope, Customer service, Digital, Sustainability, Cooperation, Entrepreneurship, Courage, Working life and Future.
Walk the route yourself and check station locations, opening hours and café prices.
Prepare the tools: a Forms form (station 2), a Padlet wall (station 4) and a Teams group (station 6). Each group needs at least one working phone.
Check filming permission and interview principles. Do not film identifiable people without permission.
Text and information were written with AI help. Have a native Finnish speaker review them.
Groups of 3–4. One group, one device for the game.
Tasks are done in the real world. The game stores no photos, answers or videos; they stay on the students’ phones.
If a task is not finished, the group may continue without the star and return later.
The game trusts the group’s confirmation. You can ask to see the output (photo, form, video, Padlet post, Teams plan).
The Digital star is one star, even though it can be practised at several stations.
The Courage and Working-life stars both belong to station 6 (the source table has no rows for them, so the criteria were drafted).
Words can be tapped. Offer sentence frames: “Hei, saanko kysyä sinulta kolme kysymystä?”, “Mitä mieltä olet…?”, “Kiitos vastauksesta.”
Let language learners sketch the solution or use their own language before writing in Finnish.
Agree a meeting point and schedule. Pyynikki’s terrain and steep stairs need suitable footwear.
Emergency: call 112. Do not share students’ personal details on public services: the Padlet wall can use group names without personal names.
What possibilities do you see now in your own future?
Which task needed most courage? What did the digital tool make possible?
How did GreenComp and DigComp show in what you did?
The panels currently hold placeholders. Add your own pictures to images/panels and link them in story.json.
Progress is stored in the browser. On a shared device delete saved progress between groups.
